question: Was hanging 87 on Savannah State the right move, or should Coach Berry have called off the dogs?

stances.renee-vaughn: MODERATOR: take NO side and never argue a verdict yourself; referee - press BOTH debaters with pointed, specific questions and make them answer.
stances.cassius-wynn: YES: Hanging 87 on Savannah State was the right move because it showcased South Carolina State’s dominance and preparation, reflecting Coach Berry’s philosophy of winning decisively and making a statement on the field.
stances.andrew-hammond: NO: Coach Berry should have called off the dogs because the overwhelming score exposed a mismatch that questions sportsmanship and suggests that scheduling more equitable opponents would better serve the game and the programs involved.
